name: streamdeck-wispr
description: Wispr Keys — Stream Deck plugin for Wispr Flow (dictation, push-to-talk, shortcuts)

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=com.sree.wispr.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && swiftc -O scripts/keys.swift -o com.sree.wispr.sdPlugin/bin/keys
scripts.pack: npm run build && mkdir -p dist && streamdeck pack com.sree.wispr.sdPlugin --output dist --force
